purpose: Historical record of the retired scripts/lf_contract_check.py compatibility bridge. New and active Contract Check callers use the canonical carrier directly.
design_invariants: The bridge path is a compatibility facade, not the Contract Check implementation.
No LF Contract Check v0.21 functional logic may remain executable behind the bridge.
Legitimate new Contract Check packets delegate to the Final Thin Carrier.
Legacy APIs that represent responsibilities outside the new Contract Check boundary remain import-compatible only as fail-closed retirement stubs.
Unsupported legacy APIs must fail closed instead of falling back to v0.21 behavior.
New callers must not bind to scripts/lf_contract_check.py.
Historical migrations and evidence references are not runtime callers and must remain immutable.
Negative guards that assert the legacy implementation is not executed must be preserved.
target_flow: caller with canonical Contract Check packet

manual compatibility workflow that delegates to pase.yml; does not execute scripts/lf_contract_check.py
negative guard proving the visual bundle does not execute scripts/lf_contract_check.py

historical_references_not_to_rewrite: historical evidence, reports and PR documentation that describe the previous implementation

live_authority_cleanup_required.current_observation: Live authority readback confirms scripts/lf_contract_check.py is absent from active governance authority and GITHUB_CONTRACT_GATE_LF source_paths; the canonical Final Thin Carrier is active.

bridge_exit_criteria: 0 tests or adapters import scripts/lf_contract_check.py for functional behavior
0 examples teach new callers to use scripts/lf_contract_check.py
0 active runtime/validation registries depend on the bridge path
0 active Supabase validator authority rows require the bridge path
all legitimate Contract Check callers use the new canonical entrypoint directly
bridge file can be deleted without changing Contract Check semantics
sunset_rule: The bridge is technical debt by design. It MUST NOT become a new permanent API or canonical Contract Check identity. Once the exit criteria are met, remove the bridge and its compatibility-only stubs in a dedicated cleanup pass.

consumer_cleanup.reason: All listed consumers were stale or already fail-closed against retired v0.21 APIs, and no active workflow references them. Domain ownership is not reassigned by this cleanup.
